name: DOOM TOWN
author: looeegy
description: Avoid the yellow gravity portal and the normal size portal at 17%. Land on the invisible slope at 18% and hold to not die to the transition at 20%. Play the following section mini. Click the bottom right of the first pink orb at 24%, click again quickly, and skip the other orbs to fall below the level between the spike and slope. Start spamming at 25.5% to get back on screen at 27%. Keep spamming to go above the level between the platforms at 29%. Fall back on screen at 35%. Spam offscreen again from 50% to 58% and maintain a constant position until the screen moves at 63%. Stay above the level to the end from there.
